name: Tamarind
siboNotes: Well tolerated in typical cooking amounts. The small serving sizes used in recipes are unlikely to trigger SIBO symptoms.
preparationTips: Use tamarind paste or concentrate rather than whole pods for easier portion control
A little goes a long way - start with 1 teaspoon in dishes
Soak tamarind pulp in warm water and strain for homemade paste
Store opened tamarind paste in refrigerator for up to 6 months
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of potassium and magnesium
Contains vitamin C and B vitamins
Provides tartaric acid which may support digestion
